name: orr
description: ORR — Operation, Resource, Revenue. Single-service deploy: backend serves the built frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.release: npm run migrate && (test "$SEED_DEMO" = "1" && npm run seed || echo '[release] skipping seed (set SEED_DEMO=1 to run it)')
